svg.aria-label: ETKDGv2 nine-step pipeline in three phases, illustrated with ethanol: parse SMILES, molecular graph, bounds matrix with triangle smoothing, distance sampling, metric-matrix eigendecomposition, BFGS bounds minimization, ETKDG torsion force field, validation checks and 3D output, with the retry loop back to embedding.
svg.text: ETKDGv2 conformer pipeline — ethanol (CCO) as the running example
V(φ) = Σₖ Vₖ (1 + sₖ cos kφ)
x, y, z for all 9 atoms
after N/4 consecutive failures → random box placement in [−5, 5]³
